items.title: Earl Turbinton Interview, 1990-09-01
items.q: I've had with, uh, David Lee and James Singleton and I with a group that we call Trinity

ctx.x: And the workshop did bear fruit. The workshop did bear fruit.

It bore many, many beautiful fruit. One of the things that I remember with the absence of David Lee, one of the things I remember with the absence of David Lee, it was very, very frustrating to try to find a drummer that could even play the concept. And when I began to form jazz groups later, one of the first groups that I, when I came back from New York and my travels, one of the first groups I formed had John Vodakovich on drums. And guys would come from the racial aspect. What are you doing with that white boy…
Okay. How do you want the workshop remembered?
